decisions.reason: The lighting clause is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; silver button and knob styling requires no further lighting-state change.
Silver DJ-booth-style controls implement the existing DJ-inspired visual theme without changing the candidate's broader visual identity state.
The candidate already requires an E on every button, and the request to explore that treatment does not necessarily alter its marking, coverage, style, or lettering color.
Silver buttons and knobs are control-specific styling and do not replace or contradict the machine's beige primary finish, green accents, or rendering-based color scheme.
The source changes control appearance and does not change the placard text, position, orientation, display sides, or wording.
The rendering reference applies specifically to buttons and knobs; it does not change the spout's appearance reference, material, or fabrication method.
The conditional styling of controls on a newly built base does not change the base graphics, logo treatment, typography, or font color.
Silver controls do not replace the support base's beige finish or its finish reference.
The source changes button appearance only and leaves the solenoid actuation mechanism and press-to-pour control behavior unchanged.
Approval of the rendered power-button appearance does not change the requirement for a dedicated user-operated machine power button.
Control styling has no necessary effect on pour smoothness, dripping prevention, beverage preservation, dispensing path, or flow behavior.
The source changes visual control styling and does not modify splash-control targets, speed conditions, or mitigation options.
